The Bonnies, led by 11th-year head coach [[Mark Schmidt]], played their home games at the [[Reilly Center]] in [[Olean, New York]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 26–8, 14–4 in [[2017–18 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in second place. They defeated [[2017–18 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2017–18 Davidson Wildcats men's basketball team|Davidson]]. They received one of the last four at-large bids to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2017–18 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] in the First Four before losing in the first round to [[2017–18 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]]. == Previous season == The [[2016–17 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|Bonnies]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 20–12, 11–7 in [[2016–17 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 play]] to finish in fifth place. They received the fifth seed in the [[2017 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] where they defeated [[2016–17 UMass Minutemen basketball team|UMass]] in the second round to advance to the quarterfinals, where they lost to [[2016–17 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team|Rhode Island]].
